---
title: "06.Coverage_abundance"
author: "Diego Coleto"
date: "2026-10-20"
output: html_document
---

Abundance of ARG contigs weighted by contig coverage, and ARG hits by host, antibiotic class and plasmid.
These quantities depend on assembly and coverage; none of them is an absolute number of gene copies. The objects
and files keep the word "copies" for continuity with the MAMI study, where it means ARG hits on contigs.

* **Abundance** of a contig set = Σ(coverage × length) / Σ(coverage × length of the whole assembly) × 1e6
  (per million coverage-weighted assembled bases), computed in `02.Contig_dataset.Rmd`. Coverage is the MEGAHIT
  k-mer coverage of each contig. Normalising by the whole assembly makes it comparable between samples with different
  depth or assembly size (the assembly equivalent of CPM; Li et al. 2024 used read-mapping coverage per million).
* Models as for the ARG load in `0.-Diet_group/Scripts/01.Diet_models.Rmd`:
  lm(log(abundance) ~ diet group + sex + age + BMI + log10 depth), marginal means and Tukey comparisons;
  origin / NOVA scores as in part 1 (z-scored, BH within system and outcome).
  Samples without multi-ARG contigs get half of the smallest non-zero value before the log.
* **ARG hits** ("copies" in the MAMI breastfeeding study, Nat Commun 2025) = ARG occurrences on contigs:
  % of hits by antibiotic class, host genus and plasmid location, per diet group. A hit conferring resistance
  to several classes counts once per class, so `ARG_copies_by_class.tsv` has one row per hit and class.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(emmeans)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(broom)

table_dir <- here("3.-Assembly_based", "Results", "Tables")
plot_dir <- here("3.-Assembly_based", "Results", "Plots")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Data load

```{r data load}
arg_sample_summary <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "arg_sample_summary.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
arg_hits <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "arg_hits.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
arg_metrics <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "arg_metrics.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
phenotypes <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Raw", "Phenotypes", "phenotypes.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
score_info <- read_tsv(here("1.-FFQ_analysis", "Results", "Tables", "score_info.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(system != "NOVA (sensitivity)")

outcomes <- c(
  "abund_ARG_contigs"       = "ARG contigs",
  "abund_multi_ARG_contigs" = "Multi-ARG contigs",
  "abund_critical_contigs"  = "Contigs with critical ARG",
  "abund_mobile_contigs"    = "Mobile ARG contigs")

model_data <- arg_sample_summary %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)),
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
         across(all_of(names(outcomes)), ~ log(.x + min(.x[.x > 0]) / 2), .names = "log_{.col}"),
         across(all_of(score_info$score), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)), .names = "{.col}_z")) %>%
  drop_na(bmi)

summary(arg_sample_summary %>% select(all_of(names(outcomes))))
cat("Samples without multi-ARG contigs:", sum(arg_sample_summary$abund_multi_ARG_contigs == 0), "\n")
```


# Agreement with the read-based resistome

```{r agreement}
agreement <- arg_sample_summary %>%
  select(sample_id, abund_ARG_contigs, ARG_copies_per_Mb) %>%
  inner_join(arg_metrics, by = "sample_id")

agreement %>%
  summarise(rho_abundance_vs_CPM = cor(abund_ARG_contigs, total_ARG_CPM, method = "spearman"),
            rho_copies_vs_CPM = cor(ARG_copies_per_Mb, total_ARG_CPM, method = "spearman"))
```


# Diet group

```{r diet models}
covariates <- "sex + age + bmi + log10_depth"

diet_fits <- map(names(outcomes), ~ lm(as.formula(paste0("log_", .x, " ~ diet_group + ", covariates)), data = model_data)) %>%
  set_names(names(outcomes))

diet_estimates <- imap_dfr(diet_fits, ~ emmeans(.x, ~ diet_group) %>%
                             confint(level = 0.95) %>%
                             as.data.frame() %>%
                             transmute(outcome = .y, diet_group, estimate = emmean,
                                       conf_low = lower.CL, conf_high = upper.CL))

diet_comparisons <- imap_dfr(diet_fits, ~ emmeans(.x, pairwise ~ diet_group, adjust = "tukey")$contrasts %>%
                               test() %>%
                               as.data.frame() %>%
                               separate(contrast, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " - ") %>%
                               transmute(outcome = .y, group1, group2, estimate, SE, p.adj = p.value,
                                         p.signif = case_when(p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                                              p.adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
                                                              p.adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
                                                              TRUE ~ "ns"))) %>%
  as_tibble()

diet_comparisons %>% mutate(outcome = outcomes[outcome]) %>% print(n = Inf)
```

```{r plot functions}
set_relative_pvalue_positions <- function(comparison_df,
                                          estimate_df,
                                          lower_padding = 0.50,
                                          bracket_start = 0.12,
                                          bracket_step = 0.10,
                                          upper_padding = 0.08) {
  data_min <- min(estimate_df$conf_low, na.rm = TRUE)
  data_max <- max(estimate_df$conf_high, na.rm = TRUE)
  data_range <- data_max - data_min

  if (!is.finite(data_range) || data_range == 0) {
    data_range <- abs(data_max) * 0.1
    if (data_range == 0) {
      data_range <- 1}}

  comparison_df <- comparison_df %>%
    mutate(y.position = data_max +
             data_range * bracket_start +
             data_range * bracket_step * (row_number() - 1))

  y_lower <- data_min - data_range * lower_padding
  y_upper <- max(comparison_df$y.position, na.rm = TRUE) + data_range * upper_padding

  list(comparison = comparison_df,
       limits = c(y_lower, y_upper))}

plot_means <- function(outcome_i) {
  estimate_df <- diet_estimates %>% filter(outcome == outcome_i)
  positions <- set_relative_pvalue_positions(diet_comparisons %>% filter(outcome == outcome_i), estimate_df)

  ggplot(estimate_df, aes(x = diet_group, y = estimate, colour = diet_group)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high), width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors, guide = "none") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(positions$comparison,
                       xmin = "group1",
                       xmax = "group2",
                       y.position = "y.position",
                       label = "p.signif",
                       bracket.size = 0.8,
                       tip.length = 0.01,
                       size = 4) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = positions$limits, clip = "off") +
    labs(title = outcomes[outcome_i], x = NULL, y = "log(abundance per million assembled bases)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = unname(diet_colors), size = 9),
          axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
          axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
          axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5))
}
```

```{r diet plot, warning=FALSE}
plot_diet <- wrap_plots(map(names(outcomes), plot_means), nrow = 1)
plot_diet
```


# Origin and NOVA scores

```{r score models}
score_results <- expand_grid(score_info, outcome = names(outcomes)) %>%
  mutate(fit = map2(score, outcome, function(score, outcome) {
    lm(as.formula(paste0("log_", outcome, " ~ ", score, "_z + ", covariates)), data = model_data) %>%
      tidy(conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      filter(term == paste0(score, "_z")) %>%
      transmute(estimate, conf_low = conf.low, conf_high = conf.high, p_value = p.value)
  })) %>%
  unnest(fit) %>%
  group_by(system, outcome) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(endpoint = outcomes[outcome])

score_results %>%
  select(system, label, endpoint, estimate, conf_low, conf_high, p_value, p_adj) %>%
  arrange(endpoint, p_value) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r score plot, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 5}
plot_scores <- score_results %>%
  mutate(system = factor(system, levels = names(system_colors)),
         label = fct_rev(fct_inorder(label)),
         endpoint = factor(endpoint, levels = outcomes)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = label, colour = system)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high), width = 0.2, orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = p_adj < 0.05), size = 2.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = 16), labels = c("q ≥ 0.05", "q < 0.05"), name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = system_colors, name = "Classification") +
  facet_grid(system ~ endpoint, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Beta for log(abundance) per 1-SD increase", y = NULL)

plot_scores
```


# ARG copies by antibiotic class, host and plasmid

```{r copies}
copies <- arg_hits %>%
  left_join(phenotypes %>% select(AMR_variant = gene, antibiotic_class), by = "AMR_variant") %>%
  mutate(antibiotic_class = str_replace(antibiotic_class, "Tetracyclines", "Tetracycline")) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(antibiotic_class, delim = ",") %>%
  mutate(antibiotic_class = str_trim(antibiotic_class),
         location = if_else(is_plasmid, "Plasmid", "Non-plasmid"),
         genus = replace_na(genus, "Unassigned")) %>%
  left_join(arg_sample_summary %>% select(sample_id, diet_group), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)))

copies_class <- copies %>%
  count(diet_group, location, antibiotic_class, name = "copies") %>%
  group_by(diet_group) %>%
  mutate(percentage = copies / sum(copies)) %>%
  ungroup()

top_hosts <- copies %>% filter(genus != "Unassigned") %>% count(genus, sort = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 12) %>% pull(genus)

copies_host <- copies %>%
  distinct(sample_id, contig_id, AMR_start, AMR_gene, diet_group, genus, location) %>%
  mutate(genus = case_when(genus %in% top_hosts ~ genus, genus == "Unassigned" ~ "Unassigned", TRUE ~ "Other genera")) %>%
  count(diet_group, genus, location, name = "copies") %>%
  group_by(diet_group) %>%
  mutate(percentage = copies / sum(copies)) %>%
  ungroup()

copies_class %>%
  group_by(diet_group, location) %>%
  summarise(copies = sum(copies), percentage = sum(percentage), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r copies plots, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
plot_copies_class <- copies_class %>%
  mutate(antibiotic_class = fct_reorder(antibiotic_class, copies, .fun = sum)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diet_group, y = percentage, fill = antibiotic_class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ location) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors, name = "Antibiotic class") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of ARG hits in each diet group") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = unname(diet_colors)),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "right")

host_levels <- c(rev(top_hosts), "Other genera", "Unassigned")
host_colors <- c(setNames(c("#0F4C81", "#C49135", "#4C956C", "#A23E48", "#765D9A", "#2D6A8A",
                            "#E0A458", "#789447", "#C46D4A", "#5B5F97", "#D35D90", "#346B5B")[seq_along(top_hosts)],
                          top_hosts),
                 "Other genera" = "#8E8E8E", "Unassigned" = "#D0D0D0")

plot_copies_host <- copies_host %>%
  mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = rev(host_levels))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diet_group, y = percentage, fill = genus)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ location) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = host_colors, name = "Host genus") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of ARG hits in each diet group") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = unname(diet_colors)),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "right",
        legend.text = element_text(face = "italic"))

plot_copies_class / plot_copies_host
```
